name: repro-first-classify-material-code-only
title: Tighten repro-first classification to material-code bug/feature only (exempt docs/refactor/chore)
description: classifyReproFirstRequirement currently over-reaches: it marks repro-first-required for ANY story declaring files (incl. .md) and for ALL type=bug (incl. doc bugs). Those tasks cannot have a meaningful reproduce-the-failure red test. Refine it to require red/spike only when the task writes material code AND is a code-verifiable behavior change (type bug|feature with declared material-code files), keep the high/critical code-verifiable-risk safety net, and stay conservative at intake (no material files -> not required; the DEV-phase repro-evidence-binding gate re-checks once files exist). Validated by red/spike.
